name: ClipCook
description: ClipCook is a Progressive Web App (PWA) that makes it easy to clip recipes from the web. It is built using the Material You design system, so it looks great on any device. With ClipCook, you can find recipes from your favorite websites, clip them with just a few clicks, and save them on all devices. ClipCook is the perfect tool for anyone who loves to cook. It's easy to use, and it makes it fun to save and use new recipes.
